'''Paranora''' is an NPC who appears in [[Energy Hub]], [[Tethys' Deep]]. She's a Gardener from the [[Black Shores]] alongside her brother, [[Panoram]].

==Quests and Events==
{{Quests and Events|Paranora}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Paranora:''' Greetings. I'm Paranora, the Bloom Bearer responsible for human resources at the Black Shores.
:'''Paranora:''' Are you the new recruit? May I check your itinerary, please?
:'''Paranora:''' It looks like you haven't been assigned a "germination test" yet.
:{{DIcon}} A "germination test"?
:'''Paranora:''' Sorry, that's a bit technical. It's just a general test we arrange for candidates who want to become Consultants or Bloom Bearers.
:{{DIcon}} How do you gather their personal info?
:'''Paranora:''' The Tethys System is linked to all Nexus on the planet, constantly monitoring for abnormal frequencies.
:'''Paranora:''' The frequencies generated when a new resonator appears, uses their Forte, or gets Overclocked will be captured by the Nexus and uploaded to Tethys.
:'''Paranora:''' Using the computing power of the Stellar Matrices, the data we extract from these frequencies is as detailed as DNA analysis.
:'''Paranora:''' We build our candidates' profiles with this info and store them in our talent pool.
:{{DIcon}} And how do you choose the right candidate?
:'''Paranora:''' We Gardeners visit each candidate in person, check their background, and bring that information back to Tethys.
:'''Paranora:''' Tethys then determines the test content for each individual.
:'''Paranora:''' In other words, every test is tailor-made.
:'''Paranora:''' Based on what I see in you, I think you'll make a great tester.
{{Dialogue End}}
